newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KPW CLEARS 1.5 MLN NEW JELFA SHARES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KPW CLEARS 1.5 MLN NEW JELFA SHARES.

text.p: Poland's Securities Commission (KPW) on Tuesday approved for public trade between 500,000 and 1.5 million new shares of Przedsiebiorstwo Farmaceutyczne Jelfa SA, KPW said.

It said in a statement that the subscription for the large investors tranche, amounting to 1,000,000 shares, will last between 17 and 20 of February. Large investors will be allowed to bid for between 50,000 and 500,000 shares.
The small investors' tranche will amount to 500,000 shares and the subscription will last between February 24 and March 7. Small investors will be allowed for bid for up to 30,000 shares.
Jelfa now has 5.3 million shares outstanding.
